payload.blocks: Phase 1 (fgos authority locate) cannot land, and through it phases 5, 7 and 11.
payload.headline: Add apps/fgos/src/main.rs to the component-authority-doors footprint so the new authority verb can be registered?

parts.cause: apps/fgos/src/main.rs:139 lists fgos_convention::CONVENTION_DESCRIPTOR and main.rs:385 registers ConventionProvider. That is the pattern the plan copies, and there is no other registration point. The unit report is plans/261121-2110-component-authority-doors/reports/unit-261123-0819-p01-result.md, and the lead checked it on branch component-authority-doors/p01.

options.cost: One footprint line plus about 2 lines of Rust.
options.does: The planner or supervisor adds apps/fgos/src/main.rs to the plan footprint and to phases 1 and 5. A fix unit adds the two registration lines.
options.gain: The verb works as the plan intends, and phase 1 lands today.
options.harm: main.rs is a shared file. A running plan that also holds it would make admission wait.
options.label: A. Add apps/fgos/src/main.rs to the footprint

options.cost: About 100 lines across main.rs and wiring, plus a new item.
options.does: Moves provider registration out of main.rs into a list in wiring/mod.rs that main.rs reads.
options.gain: Later verbs no longer touch main.rs.
options.harm: This is a refactor of every verb's registration, outside this plan's purpose (RUL104), and main.rs still has to change once.
options.label: B. Move the registration to wiring/mod.rs

parts.recommendation: A: it is the existing pattern, it is two lines, and it is the smallest change that makes the planned verb real.

scope.allows: Adding apps/fgos/src/main.rs to the footprint of plan 261121-2110-component-authority-doors (phases 1 and 5), for registering the authority descriptor and provider only.
scope.forbids: Any other change to main.rs, and any other footprint change; the phases 2-3 question q-swxkda2x5r is separate.

parts.what: Phase 1 built the fgos-component-authority crate (7 tests pass) and the verb wiring. Every native verb must also register its descriptor and provider in apps/fgos/src/main.rs, and that file is not in the plan footprint, so the verb is routed but nothing serves it.
